newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks close up, consolidate recovery.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks close up, consolidate recovery.

text.p: Dhaka shares gained in the year's final session as they consolidated Sunday's recovery from a lingering bearishness on fresh commitment, brokers said.
The Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) all share price index rose 38.67 points or 1.71 percent at 2,300.14 on a turnover of 27.8 million taka. Of 81 traded issues, 61 rose, 18 lost and two were flat.

Brokers said the market was stabilising after nearly a month's correction. "The government's pledge to plug manipulation also assured investors," said one broker. AMCL Pran rose 75 taka to 1,584 and Square Pharama gained 74 to 1,555. Trading will remain close on Tuesday due to year-end suspension in bank transactions.
